postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The string S consists of '0' and '1' characters only.

invariants.expression: The output is the number of equivalence classes among the substrings of the given string.
invariants.description: The output must reflect the number of distinct binary strings that can be obtained by reversing even number of '1's substrings in any substring of S.
